## **Hericium Erinaceus Mushroom Extract Supplier:**  
**Hericium erinaceus mushroom extract powder** is made from Hericium erinaceus. Guanjie Biotech offers a hericium erinaceus extract powder product with multiple bioactive ingredients through water extraction. Hericium erinaceus, as a common edible and medicinal fungus, has extremely high nutritional value and medicinal value, and its polysaccharide components are particular concern. Hericium erinaceus polysaccharide powder is rich in polysaccharides, proteins, amino acids, trace elements, etc., and has significant benefits for the immune system, nervous system, intestinal health, etc.
## **what Are the Features of Hericium Erinaceus Mushroom Extract Powder?**  
•Appearance characteristics  
Hericium erinaceus polysaccharide powder is a brown powder with hygroscopicity and a particle fineness of usually above 80 mesh. Its powder is fine and easy to mix with water and other solvents. Therefore, it is suitable for the production of various health foods, nutritional supplements, and health products.  
•Main ingredients  
The main active ingredient of Hericium erinaceus polysaccharide powder is Hericium erinaceus polysaccharide. This polysaccharide has unique biological activity. The polysaccharide in Hericium erinaceus belongs to the polysaccharide of β-D-glucose. It is one of the main pharmacologically active ingredients of Hericium erinaceus. In addition, Hericium erinaceus is also rich in protein, amino acids, minerals, and some trace elements. Such as potassium, calcium, iron, zinc, etc.  
•Hygroscopicity and solubility  
Hericium erinaceus bulk extract powder has strong hygroscopicity. It can maintain good chemical activity after absorbing moisture. Its particle size is generally above 80 mesh. Therefore, Hericium Erinaceus Mushroom Extract Powder has good solubility and bioavailability. Hygroscopicity requires attention to the dryness and moisture-proofness of the storage environment during use.

When choosing **Hericium erinaceus mushroom extract powder**, multiple factors need to be considered comprehensively. The following are several key factors that companies should focus on when selecting Hericium erinaceus polysaccharide powder.  
(1) Raw material source and quality  
•Purity and quality:  
When choosing polysaccharide powder from high-quality Hericium erinaceus, ensure that the raw material source is reliable. The quality of the raw materials directly affects the purity and final effect of the polysaccharide powder.  
•Supplier certification and qualifications  
Choose suppliers with a good reputation and relevant certifications. Such as HALAL, ISO certification, etc. These certifications ensure the quality control of the production process and the traceability of raw materials.
